title: Fuzzing of decoders
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation. HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation: “a potential attacker may attempt to inject carefully crafted information designed to compromise the security of the system”.

statements.label: Fuzzing of decoders
statements.requirement: The Base45, ZLIB, CBOR, COSE and full verifier entry points SHALL be fuzzed in CI. No input may crash them, hang them, or exceed DecodeLimits. Rust SHALL use a coverage-guided fuzzer (cargo-fuzz). Kotlin SHALL use a seeded mutation fuzzer in its own test suite, which needs no dependency; a coverage-guided JVM fuzzer (Jazzer) MAY replace it once it can be pinned under the dependency policy.
